units.title: Construct the actual determinant-conditioned Gaussian mixtures
units.reader_note: The bounded-test expectation gap, total-variation bound and main query lower bounds remain open.
units.statement: For \(n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\ge4\), the actual Gaussian family \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\) is measurable. Mixing it over either determinant sign gives a genuine probability law \(P_\pm\), with the Borel-event evaluation formula below.
assumptions: Exactly \(n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\ge4\). No measurable-family, probability-kernel or normalization premise is supplied.
\(\mu\) is the same normalized Borel Haar probability on the full real orthogonal group. Both determinant signs occur.
\(\nu_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\), and \(\gamma_O\) is the existing canonical Gaussian with zero mean and covariance \(A_O^{-1}\). The state space is Borel Euclidean \(\mathbb R^n\).

Measurability, positive-definiteness justification, prior probability, mixture probability and every Borel-set evaluation are produced internally. The source omits this construction bookkeeping; it is supplied explicitly here.

notation.text: Full Haar and its two normalized sign restrictions.
Actual component Gaussian measures and their actual mixtures.

steps.title: Make the density jointly measurable
steps.text: The precision depends continuously on \(O\). The displayed density is continuous jointly in \((O,x)\), so its nonnegative extended-real form is measurable.
steps.lean: Local hAc and hpc prove continuity for the exact literal precision/density; hpm applies ENNReal.measurable_ofReal. No density measurability premise is added.

steps.title: Identify the actual measurable Gaussian family
steps.text: Use the existing exact law-density identity for every \(O\), at the unchanged source parameters. Measurability of measures with a jointly measurable density then gives measurability of the actual Gaussian family.
steps.lean: The proof calls GaussianLawDensity.gaussian_law_eq_density hn hκ O, whose internal SPD proof uses the source precision bounds, then the exact Mathlib measurable_withDensity. The conclusion concerns the actual multivariateGaussian constructor.

steps.title: Use the normalized determinant priors
steps.text: The existing half-mass theorem supplies the two literal prior probability laws. The same full Haar law is retained throughout.
steps.lean: DeterminantComponents.component_probabilities is applied at the internally derived positive dimension. Its actual2*restriction probability conclusions are installed, not supplied by the caller.

steps.title: Construct genuine probability mixtures
steps.text: Mix the same measurable Gaussian family against each probability prior. Every component Gaussian has total mass one, so both resulting measures have total mass one.
steps.lean: The actual measures are νpos.bind γ and νneg.bind γ, where bind is join of map. isProbabilityMeasure_bind consumes the proved family measurability, exact prior probabilities and actual Gaussian probability instances. No replacement density-only law or fallback kernel is defined.

steps.title: Evaluate every Borel event
steps.text: For any Borel event, the value of each actual mixture equals the corresponding average of component Gaussian probabilities. This identifies the source mixture laws; bounded-test expectation transport remains a separate step.
steps.lean: Both Measure.bind_apply calls use the measurable family already proved above. B is universally quantified in the conclusion; its Borel condition is the ordinary evaluation domain, not an additional theorem-level regularity assumption.

units.lean_statement: Exact preproof sealed signature: actual covariance Gaussian family measurability, both literal conditioned binds probability, and universal Borel evaluations; source n>=3,kappa>=4.
units.lean_proof: Joint literal density continuity and the exact actual Gaussian law-density node produce family measurability; exact component priors and canonical Mathlib bind facts produce both actual mixture laws.
units.boundary: Actual single-block Gaussian family measurability, both determinant-conditioned probability measures and their universal Borel-set evaluations only, n>=3 and kappa>=4. Source omits measurable-family/bind well-definedness bookkeeping; this supplies it without inventing an author proof. No product Eq6, mixture-density/expectation interchange, H expectation gap, TV adapter, Poisson, parameters, transcript, eigenbasis or main lower bound.
